propositions: Bedrock must be measured against a parity bar before becoming a first-class provider, requiring proof that identical payloads reach the LLM and identical tools are available across providers

The parity harness must run paired arms (direct Anthropic vs Bedrock) through the same corpus at N=3 epochs with per-pass model class held equal, excluding agentic multi-call arms from the corpus to isolate provider as the only variable

Both Bedrock inference-profile IDs (sonnet-4-6 and opus-4-8) must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 with capability differences (e.g., temperature withdrawal on opus) explicitly documented rather than hidden
Provider routing must be proven clean via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally, confirming zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm across all measured slots
Payload and tool parity must be captured at the provider boundary with real request objects, not inferred from code reading, proving system prompt/messages/tools are byte-identical across providers
